data.name: Angana
data.gender_notes: Angana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Angana is a beautiful and majestic name derived from Sanskrit and Bengali languages. This name signifies the grace and beauty of nature, especially flowers. It is a perfect name for a baby girl who is loved and cherished just like a beautiful and graceful flower. The name Angana carries the meaning “Majestic, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Angana usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Angana is a name that represents the feminine aspect of the divine and signifies grace, beauty, and elegance. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hinduism and is often associated with the goddesses Lakshmi and Saraswati.
data.etymology: Angana belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Angana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Angana was a famous courtesan of the Gupta Empire in the 5th century AD. She was known for her extraordinary beauty and musical talent. Her name is mentioned in the works of several famous poets of the time, including Kalidasa.

Angana is also mentioned in the epic Mahabharata as the name of a beautiful and accomplished princess of the Anga kingdom. She was a sister of the famous warrior Bhima, and was revered for her wisdom and grace.
